source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: Open with Imperial Lash to root and dash onto their carry, then drop Queen’s Garden under them so allies cash in the Thorns bonus. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith finish by minute 21, keep Iron Rose up and front every fight.
support.issue: tells you to open the engage yourself, contradicting the watch-out and the all-theirs matchup list
support.rewrite: After a teammate commits, Imperial Lash to root and dash onto their carry, then drop Queen’s Garden under them so allies cash in the Thorns bonus. Once Stonewall and Warden's Faith finish by minute 21, keep Iron Rose up and stand in front.

jungle.quote: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win the straight fight, so clear your own camps and gank sidelanes instead of invading.
jungle.issue: blanket 'never invade' ignores the Rampage and Boris matchups the SOURCE calls ours
jungle.rewrite: Khaimera, Kwang and Feng Mao win the straight fight, so clear your own camps and gank sidelanes instead of invading into them — Rampage and Boris are fights you can take.

support.quote: Peel with Ether Crystal: it shoves divers off your carry, then pulls them back in as it implodes, and follow with Dread Nova to stun. Stonewall and Warden's Faith by minute 21 let you body-block instead of kiting.
support.issue: three MOBA-only terms ('peel', 'divers', 'kiting') a brand-new player won't get
support.rewrite: Use Ether Crystal to protect your carry: it shoves attackers off them, then pulls them back in as it implodes, and follow with Dread Nova to stun. Stonewall and Warden's Faith by minute 21 let you block for them instead of backing away.

offlane.quote: Greystone, Steel and Zarus beat you early, so hold Glacial Charge as an escape and farm until your team collapses.
offlane.issue: 'farm until your team collapses' reads as your own team falling apart
offlane.rewrite: Greystone, Steel and Zarus beat you early, so hold Glacial Charge as an escape and farm until your team can join you.

support.quote: Engaging before your carry is in range leaves you alone in their backline, so use Glacial Charge to leave, not enter.
support.issue: contradicts line 1's instruction to start fights with Glacial Charge
support.rewrite: Engaging before your carry is in range leaves you alone behind their team, so wait until they can follow you in before you use Glacial Charge.

midlane.quote: Gideon and The Fey out-range you, so never Shadow Slip in without the swap or Feast ready to get you out.
midlane.issue: Feast is a leap onto an enemy hero, not an escape
midlane.rewrite: Gideon and The Fey out-range you, so never Shadow Slip in without saving the swap to get you back out.

jungle.quote: Kwang wins the straight fight, so clear camps and gank instead of invading, and keep the Shadow to slip out.
jungle.issue: blanket 'don't invade' ignores Serath, Rampage, Boris and Feng Mao being ours
jungle.rewrite: Kwang wins the straight fight, so stay off his side of the jungle — invade into Serath, Rampage, Boris or Feng Mao instead, and keep the Shadow to slip out.

midlane.quote: Black Hole can't be cancelled once cast — don't open with it alone; wait for a teammate's stun or the enemy to commit first.
midlane.issue: SOURCE says Black Hole cannot be cancelled after its channel, not from the instant it is cast
midlane.rewrite: Once Black Hole has finished channelling it can't be cancelled — don't open with it alone; wait for a teammate's stun or the enemy to commit first.

offlane.quote: Steel and Zarus win this lane — Stone Forged Soul buys one reset, not two, so back off after using it.
offlane.issue: 'one reset, not two' is a usage limit the SOURCE never states, and 'reset' is jargon
offlane.rewrite: Steel and Zarus win this lane — once you have spent Stone Forged Soul to heal up, back off instead of staying for another trade.

jungle.quote: Gank with Assault The Gates — hitting a hero cuts its cooldown — then Make Way to shred armor and Sacred Oath to cleave. Stone Forged Soul turns a losing dive into a reset; Krix adds tankiness, not damage.
jungle.issue: 'turns a losing dive into a reset' is jargon a brand-new player won't get
jungle.rewrite: Gank with Assault The Gates — hitting a hero cuts its cooldown — then Make Way to shred armor and Sacred Oath to cleave. Stone Forged Soul heals you back up when a dive goes wrong; Krix adds tankiness, not damage.

offlane.quote: Lay Flame Turrets in the bushes, then Oil Spill across the lane and ignite it with Molotov to hold them off the wave. Basic attacks stack Slick for extra burn; Wraith Leggings by minute 25 lets you kite the dive.
offlane.issue: 'kite the dive' is jargon a brand-new player won't get
offlane.rewrite: Lay Flame Turrets in the bushes, then Oil Spill across the lane and ignite it with Molotov to hold them off the wave. Basic attacks stack Slick for extra burn; Wraith Leggings by minute 25 lets you walk away from whoever jumps you.

offlane.quote: Melee bruisers kill turrets fast — when one jumps you, save Inferno's knockback to break the gap rather than burning it for damage.
offlane.issue: 'break the gap' is not idiomatic English
offlane.rewrite: Melee bruisers kill turrets fast — when one jumps you, save Inferno's knockback to shove them off you rather than burning it for damage.

offlane.quote: Poke with Judgement of the Heavens, then Surge of the Heavens into the blade to snap it back and knock them up. Landing abilities speeds your cooldowns; by minute 24 you can stand in the fight and keep swinging.
offlane.issue: abilities only Energize the blade; the cooldown cut comes from the energized basic attack hitting a hero
offlane.rewrite: Poke with Judgement of the Heavens, then Surge of the Heavens into the blade to snap it back and knock them up. Landing an ability Energizes your blade, and the lightning basic attack that follows cuts your cooldowns; by minute 24 you can stand in the fight and keep swinging.

midlane.quote: Against Gideon, The Fey, Countess or Iggy & Scorch you lose the poke war, so hold Seismic Assault for their engage and farm safely.
midlane.issue: invents a 'poke war' reason the SOURCE doesn't give (Countess is not a poke matchup)
midlane.rewrite: Gideon, The Fey, Countess and Iggy & Scorch all come out ahead in this lane, so hold Seismic Assault for their engage and farm safely.

support.quote: Against Dekker you lose the checkpoint trade, so stop walking up for Seismic Assault and use Void Drone for vision while your carry farms.
support.issue: internal jargon: 'lose the checkpoint trade' means nothing to a new player
support.rewrite: Dekker comes out ahead in this lane, so stop walking up for Seismic Assault and use Void Drone for vision while your carry farms.

carry.quote: Drop Static Trap on the path they must walk, then open with Buckshot up close for the armor shred and chase with Hot Pursuit while you basic attack. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done by minute 19 those attack chains kill on their own.
carry.issue: advises point-blank Buckshot, but its knockback pushes the target away — the next line says the opposite
carry.rewrite: Drop Static Trap on the path they must walk, then use Buckshot as they step in for the armor shred — it pushes them back, so keep your distance and keep basic attacking with Hot Pursuit up. Once Viper and Deathstalker are done by minute 19 those attack chains kill on their own.

offlane.quote: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all win the checkpoint trade, so give up the wave, farm under tower and ping for your jungler.
offlane.issue: internal jargon: 'win the checkpoint trade' (and 'ping') will not read to a new player
offlane.rewrite: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all come out ahead in this lane, so give up the wave, farm under tower and ask your jungler for help.

offlane.quote: Poke with Line Tempo, then dash in with Rushing Beat and turn on Circle Rhythm for the shield while your wolves chew on them. Once Spectral Schematics and Timewarp land by minute 19, every ability that hits builds Track; cash it with All-Kill!
offlane.issue: ties Track stacking to an item timing — Track comes from the kit, not from Spectral Schematics or Timewarp
offlane.rewrite: Poke with Line Tempo, then dash in with Rushing Beat and turn on Circle Rhythm for the shield while your wolves chew on them. Every ability that damages a hero builds Track — at 8 stacks cash it in with All-Kill! — and Spectral Schematics and Timewarp by minute 19 make that rotation hit harder.

carry.quote: Most enemy carries beat you early — if Murdock, Drongo or Eden are shoving, farm safely with Piercing Shot instead of trading basics.
carry.issue: 'shoving' is jargon a brand-new player won't get
carry.rewrite: Most enemy carries come out ahead in this lane — if Murdock, Drongo or Eden are pushing the wave into you, farm safely with Piercing Shot instead of trading basic attacks.

offlane.quote: Wild Rush's long channel gets punished by Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus — don't start fights with it; use it to escape or follow up.
offlane.issue: SOURCE says Wild Rush makes Terra Unstoppable while she channels, so 'gets punished' misstates the risk
offlane.rewrite: Greystone, Steel, Aurora and Zarus all come out ahead in this lane, and Wild Rush needs up to a 3.5s wind-up, so don't open fights with it — use it to escape or follow up.

jungle.quote: Open with Q Lash Kick to yank yourself onto them and slow them hard, turn on E Windburn, then keep attacking — every third hit deals bonus damage and heals you. Solaris, Viper and Spear Of Desolation by minute 25 make that chain finish kills.
jungle.issue: reads as if Windburn's active causes the every-third-hit bonus and heal; that is its passive
jungle.rewrite: Open with Q Lash Kick to yank yourself onto them and slow them hard, turn on E Windburn for the extra range and cleave, then keep attacking — Windburn's passive makes every third attack in a row deal bonus damage and heal you. Solaris, Viper and Spear Of Desolation by minute 25 make that chain finish kills.
